file_stem.description: Base name used to create output files for this CV run.

job_description_stem.description: Stem used to locate the job description text/markdown file. Use null if no job description is used.

recruiter_message_stem.description: Stem used to locate recruiter message text/markdown file. Use null if absent.

optional_obs.description: Output filename context label. If null, it is inferred from job/recruiter inputs.

cv_context.description: Optional manual guidance applied across CV generation prompts.
cv_context.example: Keep the CV concise and position me as a senior data scientist with strong product and engineering judgment.

role_context.description: Optional manual guidance applied specifically to role evidence selection and work experience bullet generation.
role_context.example: For PicPay, emphasize segmentation, statistical rigor, and bridging analytics with software engineering.

skills_context.description: Optional manual guidance applied specifically to Skills & Stack generation.
skills_context.example: Prioritize forecasting, deployment, Python, SQL, and cloud tooling; de-emphasize dashboard-only skills.

role_variant.description: Prompt variant used when generating professional experience bullets.

academic_variant.description: Prompt variant used when generating academic or technical profile content.

role_max_bullets.description: Maximum number of generated bullets per selected professional role.

academic_max_bullets.description: Maximum number of generated bullets for academic/profile sections.

selected_role_ids.description: Role IDs selected from the workbook for this CV version.

source_file.description: Local workbook used for static sheets such as language_skills, text_blocks, and contact_info.

workbook_path.description: Local path where the master Google Sheets workbook is downloaded as xlsx.

render_xlsx_path.description: Local path for the generated render workbook consumed by the R Markdown/Quarto CV template.

render_output_dir.description: Directory where rendered HTML/PDF files are written.

drive_sheet_folder.description: Google Drive folder where the generated render spreadsheet is uploaded.

input_file.description: R Markdown/Quarto CV template used for rendering.

pdf_mode.description: Whether to also generate a PDF using pagedown::chrome_print after HTML rendering.

max_categories.description: Maximum number of Skills & Stack categories generated by generate_cv_entries().

use_expertise.description: Whether the Skills & Stack generation should use the expertise column.

master_drive_file_id.description: Google Drive file ID of the master CV spreadsheet to download.

html_drive_folder.description: Google Drive folder where rendered HTML CV files are uploaded.

pdf_drive_folder.description: Google Drive folder where rendered PDF CV files are uploaded.
